heroHeadline: Canada Finalizes C$27.6B Retaliation After Trump Tells Carney to 'Fall in Line'
heroSubtitle: Trump escalated Aug 24, telling Canada to 'fall in line' or face consequences 'far WORSE,' threatening new 50% tariffs on autos, trucks and steel from Jan 1, 2027 and calling Carney 'Governor Carney.' Carney rejected the framing as treating Canada 'as a subsidiary of the United States.' Ottawa responded Aug 25 by finalizing its retaliation: sliding 15/25/50% tariffs on C$27.6B of US goods (steel, aluminum, dairy, furniture, cosmetics, smartphones, seafood, appliances, textiles), paired with a C$7.5B worker and business support package, taking effect Sept 8.
